integrity: The arbitrary-parameter theorem is proved algebraically from a classical structural characterization and direct coordinate calculations. The bundled finite computation is corroborative only and is not used as an infinite proof or as a novelty certificate.
scientific_limitations: Specific to nondegenerate Euclidean tetrahedra with concentric insphere and circumsphere. It does not address off-center nested spheres, higher-dimensional simplices, or ellipsoids. Historical noncoverage is supported by targeted modern-source inspection but older disphenoid literature remains a residual risk.
title: Sharp volume interval for concentric bicentric tetrahedra
